+import os
+from datetime import datetime, timezone
+from typing import Any, Dict, Optional
+
+import requests
+
+
+GRAPHITE_BASE_URL = os.getenv("GRAPHITE_BASE_URL", "https://graphite.example.com")
+GRAPHITE_API_TOKEN = os.getenv("GRAPHITE_API_TOKEN", "")
+
+
+def _parse_iso8601(value: str) -> datetime:
+    normalized = value.replace("Z", "+00:00")
+    dt = datetime.fromisoformat(normalized)
+    if dt.tzinfo is None:
+        dt = dt.replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc)
+    return dt
+
+
+def _to_unix_seconds(dt: datetime) -> int:
+    return int(dt.timestamp())
+
+
+def aggregate_metric_stats(metric_name: str, start_time: str, end_time: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+    start_dt = _parse_iso8601(start_time)
+    end_dt = _parse_iso8601(end_time)
+    if end_dt <= start_dt:
+        raise ValueError("end_time must be after start_time")
+
+    url = f"{GRAPHITE_BASE_URL.rstrip('/')}/render"
+    params = {
+        "target": f"{metric_name}",
+        "from": _to_unix_seconds(start_dt),
+        "until": _to_unix_seconds(end_dt),
+        "format": "json",
+    }
+    headers = {}
+    if GRAPHITE_API_TOKEN:
+        headers["Authorization"] = f"Bearer {GRAPHITE_API_TOKEN}"
+
+    response = requests.get(url, params=params, headers=headers, timeout=30)
+    response.raise_for_status()
+    payload = response.json()
+
+    values = []
+    for series in payload:
+        datapoints = series.get("datapoints", [])
+        for value, _timestamp in datapoints:
+            if value is not None:
+                values.append(float(value))
+
+    count = len(values)
+    total = sum(values)
+    minimum = min(values) if values else None
+    maximum = max(values) if values else None
+    average = (total / count) if count else None
+
+    return {
+        "provider": "graphite",
+        "metric_name": metric_name,
+        "start_time": start_dt.astimezone(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
+        "end_time": end_dt.astimezone(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
+        "count": count,
+        "sum": total,
+        "min": minimum,
+        "max": maximum,
+        "average": average,
+    }
+
*** End Patch

+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import os
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone
+from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional
+
+import requests
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class MetricDatapoint:
+    timestamp: datetime
+    value: float
+
+
+def _parse_iso8601(value: str) -> datetime:
+    if value.endswith("Z"):
+        value = value[:-1] + "+00:00"
+    dt = datetime.fromisoformat(value)
+    if dt.tzinfo is None:
+        dt = dt.replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc)
+    return dt
+
+
+def query_metric_window(
+    metric_name: str,
+    window_minutes: int = 60,
+    *,
+    project_id: Optional[str] = None,
+    alignment_period_seconds: int = 60,
+) -> List[MetricDatapoint]:
+    api_key = os.environ.get("MIXPANEL_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_SECRET")
+    if not api_key:
+        raise RuntimeError("Missing MIXPANEL_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_SECRET")
+
+    project_id = project_id or os.environ.get("MIXPANEL_PROJECT_ID")
+    if not project_id:
+        raise RuntimeError("Missing MIXPANEL_PROJECT_ID")
+
+    end_time = datetime.now(timezone.utc)
+    start_time = end_time - timedelta(minutes=window_minutes)
+
+    url = "https://eu.mixpanel.com/api/query/engage"
+    params: Dict[str, Any] = {
+        "project_id": project_id,
+        "event": metric_name,
+        "from_date": start_time.date().isoformat(),
+        "to_date": end_time.date().isoformat(),
+        "unit": "minute",
+        "interval": alignment_period_seconds,
+    }
+    response = requests.get(url, params=params, auth=(api_key, ""), timeout=30)
+    response.raise_for_status()
+    payload = response.json()
+
+    points: List[MetricDatapoint] = []
+    data = payload.get("data", []) if isinstance(payload, dict) else []
+    for item in data:
+        if not isinstance(item, dict):
+            continue
+        ts = item.get("timestamp") or item.get("time") or item.get("date")
+        val = item.get("value") or item.get("count") or item.get("total")
+        if ts is None or val is None:
+            continue
+        points.append(MetricDatapoint(timestamp=_parse_iso8601(str(ts)), value=float(val)))
+
+    points.sort(key=lambda p: p.timestamp)
+    return [p for p in points if start_time <= p.timestamp <= end_time]
+
*** End Patch
